applied.problem: The opening says any year's growth split into more parts settles on about 2.718, but that holds only at a 100% rate (at 5% it settles on 1.0513, as the lesson later shows); also £271.81 − £271.46 reads as 35p, so the 36p (35.6p exactly) needs an "about".
"A little above paying once" fails at large rates (at 100% a year it is e ≈ 2.718 against 2), and 2,000 × 2.718 × 0.2 is £1,087.20, not £1,087.31, which needs e itself.
